description: CARRIER LEVEL from EXPERIMENTS: the level of one frequency, a 12.5 kHz channel read every 2 ms on any radio the board has (LR2021, RTL-SDR, HackRF): now in big figures, the board's VFD bargraph holding the last second's peak, the second and the whole run as spans on a -100 to 0 dBFS scale, and a braille history of the level.
